about: Who is who in the chronicle, kept here as data so that no source file names a person. 'aliases' maps a name as the old records wrote it (a first name only, a typo, an older spelling) to the full name of the person it is; keys compare case-insensitively. 'honours' gives the order's lore a standing that no Faxing records: 'founder' (Eldsterådet, who made the game), 'saint' or 'pope', by full name. Left out of 'aliases' on purpose until someone decides who they are: William, Henrik, Kasper, Eirik, Erik, Kristian, Magnus byrkj, Sofie.
